The implementation uses a fixed desktop workspace boundary with explicit independently scrollable panes, rather than clipping document overflow or shrinking text. Short/narrow/high-zoom layouts return to natural scrolling. The central result stays visible while the contextual editor changes, and detailed annual schedules take the whole working width.
text.d9b39a031055b6ec950f: Guided now mounts all assumption groups once per company/path render and toggles their visibility. Existing input nodes, focused edits, source disclosures and simulation mounts survive view switching. Annual’s per-year editor delegates to the same authoritative exact schedule-cell handlers; revenue levels remain independent inputs. Nonmodal evidence panels move and restore real nodes, support Escape, remember scroll and restore focus; covered inputs are inert. Historical follows the same composition while retaining original handler and node identities. Research and Learn use the common rail, type, spacing, theme tokens and bounded reading panes.
text.9b6272d6e28350f2ac08: The supplied Belgrade Arbor reference was read through its accessible public page. Named destinations, numbered sections and deliberate primary actions informed the hierarchy; this is not a claim to have visually inspected its motion or copied a 3D experience. Navy and warm neutral surfaces form the default palette, with one accent, selective serif headings and tabular sans-serif data. Small state feedback and interruptible panels use consistent short timing ranges. The separately requested six-second simulation replay remains optional and mathematically unchanged.
text.2c7f7549dd1c8d834f4a: `SCREEN-WORKSPACE.md` contains the detailed design/verification contract. New automated lifecycle checks supplement the original calculations and preset suite. Before/after images are expressly static renderer approximations. Browser execution, actual page-scroll measurements, native keyboard/touch/AT behavior and a genuine short interaction recording remain unverified due to the existing browser-access restriction. No synthetic animation is presented as a recording.
text.fced215516d7989dd126: 17 October 2026 · One continuous page, visible feedback
text.1401eb9fd879e194822d: The latest user feedback supersedes the preceding screen-sized brief: the whole page should scroll naturally, with no scrollbar in any subsection, including a wide table. The correction removes the old scroll constraints themselves. It does not conceal scrollbars while leaving an inaccessible scrollport. Guided, Annual, Historical, Simulation and reading pages share ordinary document flow; evidence becomes a normal-flow column, and narrow annual tables become labeled row groups using the existing exact input nodes.
text.a1d73b18a924fc0acf3b: Written primary guidance reread for this correction, 17 October 2026:
text.df7b3afdef4a09e8c901: : the guidance permits genuine two-dimensional table exceptions, but does not require a scroller. This user's preference is met by responsive rows. Surrounding text must still fit, and sticky content needs particular care at smaller sizes. Phone summaries therefore remain in flow.
text.027820e18fa4268149ff: : retain captions and programmatic relationships between headers and data. Responsive presentation preserves native table, row and cell elements, scopes and exact controls; explicit same-role attributes reinforce those relationships when CSS uses grid/block display. No screen-reader conformance claim is made without browser/AT verification.
text.1b0119cf4c89ce420a99: : nonessential interaction motion can be disabled. Panel and result feedback honor the current reduced-motion preference and interrupt immediately when it changes. The reference is a Level AAA criterion, not evidence of whole-app conformance.
text.6159c1c277801c87962d: : cancel releases an animation's effects. The implementation also removes old callbacks and guards completion by animation identity so a canceled transition cannot interfere with a newer one.
text.e37a66aa7732ea5a1fc1: The old interface had named motion tokens but mostly painted a subtle 180–200 ms opacity fade. The concrete fix attaches 280 ms opacity plus 8px travel to the shipped view/group handlers and drawing underlines to selected tabs. Input edits instead animate only the updated result/chart with 4px feedback, never the editor. Data and focus commit synchronously; repeated active-tab clicks do not create another entrance. Monte Carlo's exact final histogram and optional six-second replay are unchanged.
text.e63158dab2671402429f: Evidence Open is an explicit navigation action: reveal its header only when offscreen, including a repeated open. Close and Escape return to the prior page position and invoking control. Normal edits and tab changes do not force scrolling. Notes grow on typing, reveal, focus and resize, including older browsers using the JavaScript fallback. The observer processes changed subtrees so particle playback does not repeatedly reannotate every annual cell.
text.0a57dc0d554c0fca2ca2: Verification uses source/cascade checks plus actual production handlers under synthetic DOM/WAAPI fixtures. The prior 800 numerical, source and interaction checks remain, with 19 additional flow, cancellation, reduced-motion, exact-input and evidence-position tests. Independent static before/after document renders show layout approximations at desktop and phone sizes; these are not screenshots from a browser and cannot establish native page scroll geometry, painted motion performance, touch, focus visibility or screen-reader behavior. No video lesson was watched in this cycle, and no denied browser route was retried. Financial sources, frozen cases, engines and sampling rules are untouched.
text.e57ef69b6640d2a4e02e: 2026-10-18 · Optional interim margin and final fade
text.4ba9e330cd06c156e05e: Added opt-in interim margin, arrival year, plateau/fade start, terminal margin and independent terminal-margin year in Guided and Year-by-year. Actual all-year margin charts show the generated path, including equal start/end levels with an interim peak.
text.488c4f8555c295cec114: Kept normalized/source starting margins and explicitly labeled the AAOI/NBIS unavailable-anchor proxy. Repeated edits preserve source/proxy provenance. Disabled/default cases retain their previous economics.
text.255c29e4dc67a66a1be3: Profitability and revenue maturity remain independent. Margin-only extensions preserve existing revenue/capital/tax/WACC; manual annual margin edits remain explicit overrides. Primary Undo restores the full preceding phase edit.
text.16dbf6bd5698f6344aba: Active-phase Monte Carlo keeps the starting margin fixed, shifts future targets, preserves manual offsets and excludes infeasible draws without clipping. Effective metadata describes the sampled curve.
text.aae934cdf98ba2bc14f9: Updated two pinned code signatures for intentional margin provenance/reset and effective-path numeric checks; frozen financial-data and numeric-oracle hashes are unchanged.
text.ba8c76bbd6b49708e7b5: Renamed the user-facing Annual mode to Year-by-year, preserving routes, saved model identities and annual historical-table terminology. Added a concise distinction from Guided.
text.da8f2ef0526510dda30b: Added immediate 10/15/20-year revenue-stability scenarios with an explicit capital assumption and full Undo. Near-term revenue paths remain; later growth fades over the selected duration. It does not hold the initial growth rate flat for 20 years.
text.0b68535361c5da17177e: Kept calendar-year margins, taxes and discount rates separate. The explicit cash-flow schedule retains original economic years and any retained later economic assumptions, so growth stable in year 10 can coexist with a 15-year cash-flow schedule.
text.b27ca58d38eeaa7b25f9: Added a versioned derived-draft path rather than weakening frozen-source restoration. Original research cases and saved v1 drafts retain their exact numbers until the user deliberately derives another path.
text.6b85a84a201f68fec8eb: Growth requires investment: derived scenarios preserve spending floors, scale positive investment upward with sales and fund additional expansion under an explicit marginal sales/capital assumption. Added mature years use terminal-ROIC-compatible capital intensity. This is a sensitivity, not a rebuilt company capacity, maintenance or customer-advance budget.
text.48326caa4c49071deb64: Monte Carlo uses the same capital response on the current edited schedule before any investment multiplier. Original v1 seeded results remain unchanged; claim pricing, date/currency policies and stale-result protections remain.
text.ab35290a2e88b363e539: 2026-10-18 · Dated capital and dilution scenarios (research cutoff October 17)
text.316ab0d6706f35b33fc3: Added explicit current-capital and existing-share controls in Annual → Claims, with matching remaining-year timing and full load/edit Undo. Saved drafts are never silently replaced.
text.87ff37fa8e6aa343921c: AAOI now has a selected conditional option-inclusive scenario: dated/estimated cash and current shares, existing award sensitivity, discounted note cash flows and a joint dilution-adjusted European approximation for note/warrant claims. Volatility, credit spread, risk-free proxy and warrant coverage are editable; each simulation draw reprices the claims. The reference estimate is about $40/share, not a claim of exact security fair value.
text.d5cd7f7c6caa35fc8778: NBIS now displays a dynamic pre-claim diagnostic with current cash/share estimates. Its selected owned-build case has a negative residual even before unresolved debt/option claims; common fair value remains explicitly unresolved rather than represented as zero. Lower-capex alternatives can change that result.
text.abde638d58a5c75b1306: Completed financing cash and ownership are matched. Future financing dilution is not added again to negative FCFF; existing awards and option claims have separate treatments. Invalid capital inputs withhold equity output without hiding valid operating forecasts.
text.e9f85eebd398a5908125: Added a source-linked explanation at `dist/data/current-capital-scenarios-2026-10-17.html`. Original frozen forecasts, raw research and all other twelve company calculations remain unchanged. No account, API, audience or GitHub permission change.
text.d67c7fb62e7b9b20e2a4: The AAOI claim approximation omits contract-specific early exercise, calls, make-whole, averaging, default and vesting paths. The NBIS diagnostic is not a complete security appraisal. Verification: full regression run 906 checks, 904 passed, one unchanged external AAOI raw-cache rebuild failure and one existing cache skip. Final affected UI checks passed 77/77; subsequent narrow control/style checks passed 40/40; final pure-model/integration checks passed 44/44. Independent 50-draw simulation replay and all other twelve company defaults/outputs match expectations. Native browser execution remains unverified; source-driven static desktop/phone review is a separate check.
text.00ab388c4eed9c5ff16d: 2026-10-17, 23:30 UTC · Keep history open while editing
text.f1d1f048bd9a8756f00c: Guided now shows every available annual observation for the selected metric by default, with secondary measures under Related historical comparisons. Risk displays source-linked, dated WACC components instead of an empty summary; terminal growth and ROIC retain their economic/proxy limitations.
text.d60fba263731b0e783a6: View history switches the permanent right column in one click. Input focus and edits follow the selected metric, preserving exact input/evidence nodes and updating the comparison without focus or scroll jumps. Selections survive ordinary refreshes; company, source and cutoff changes rebuild dated evidence.
text.522ffb2b38bffa428cbd: Why and full Sources & comparability remain available. Annual/Historical evidence also leaves original inputs interactive; live Annual result evidence refreshes without repeated entry motion.
text.0a1661518366565fd157: Desktop retains the value summary and side-by-side inputs/evidence; mobile uses whole-page flow with inputs first. No financial model, research source, simulation policy, draft namespace or sharing change.
text.347636d67b03bacc058a: Focused shipped-handler tests cover repeated history/source switches, same- and different-field edits, keyboard selection, source-date changes, missing data and node identity. Full-suite and independent preservation results are recorded in the final release verification. Native-browser layout, touch, screen-reader output and recording remain unverified. See SCREEN-WORKSPACE.md for dated primary accessibility sources and exact scope.
text.b0bc0783bcd37a62676b: Implemented the supplied ivory/teal Instrument Serif + DM Sans design across the existing workspace, with self-hosted licensed fonts, compact global/mode navigation, editable assumptions on the left and sourced context on the right. Guided output destinations are now clearly labeled Forecast, Valuation range and Annual tables while route IDs, six stored themes and all existing product capabilities remain intact.
text.528da9f688ba3add3aa3: Growth displays every actual model year through stable growth, with keyed, signed, responsive animated bars. Profitability uses the calculated final forecast EBIT/NOPAT row. Input uncertainty shapes animate independently from real simulation outputs; prior/pending/failed output and export rules remain unchanged. Model/source/research files are not changed. See the repository’s APPROVED-UI.md for the capability map, design source, exact motion, accessibility rationale and honest verification limits.
text.a2187afd59c260177fc3: New review images are static approximations. Native-browser layout and motion recording remain unverified under the existing access restriction. The restored baseline's external AAOI raw-source fixture remains missing; the assertion is unchanged.
